harbor_agent_timeout.basis: the agent runs rl-exposure, sft-exposure and sft-time in series; v3 also encloses the sum of their walls plus 300 s

instrument: derive_plan.py measure_v2_timing: guard.json and resources.jsonl receipts, local_training.json active_time_audit, active_time invocation json, actor.log train_runtime, and training/* file mtimes relative to the guard start (mtime(resources.jsonl) - last row elapsed_seconds)

rl-exposure.killed_during: audit-only reload replay (_evaluate on the reloaded adapter), per the actor.log traceback
rl-exposure.projection: elapsed at kill + one after-train-diagnostic duration, because the replay re-runs that diagnostic and had already started. Lower bound: elapsed at kill. Unverified assumption: the replay costs no more than the after-train diagnostic did

rule: every wall >= 2x its measured or projected need; outer walls = inner + 300 s

sft-exposure.basis: same native argv as the probe except --stage-id (1 step, train-only, same post-train audit), so the v2 probe measures it. It never ran in v2

sft-time.basis: probe fixed non-step seconds + RL committed active seconds x probe train_runtime/active ratio. It resumes sft-exposure's step, so its new steps' active time is below the target. It never ran in v2

verify.basis: unmeasured: never ran in v1 or v2. verify_submission loads the model and greedily decodes <= 4 images, a subset of the probe's start + model load + 8-row before-train diagnostic
